content:
AAEON BOXER-8741AI is an industrial edge AI box PC built around the NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 module, delivering up to 2070 FP4 TFLOPS (sparse) of AI performance and featuring 128GB LPDDR5X memory. Designed for humanoid robotics, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), and multi-sensor perception workloads,  it features two 10GbE and four 5GbE ports, two CAN FD interfaces, RS-232/RS-485, optional GPIO, and four USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports. Expansion options include M.2 slots for NVMe storage, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and 4G/5G cellular connectivity. The computer supports 19V to 48V DC input and operates from -20°C to 60°C for industrial applications. AAEON BOXER-8741AI specifications: SoM – NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 module CPU – 14-core 64-bit ARM Neoverse-V3AE @ up to 2.6GHz GPU – 2560-core NVIDIA Blackwell GPU with 96 fifth-generation Tensor Cores, Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) support with 10 Texture Processing Clusters (TPCs) VPU Video Decode – 4x 8Kp30 (H.265), 10x 4Kp60 (H.265), 22x 4Kp30 (H.265), [...]
